BitMine Adds 12,535 ETH, Total Holdings Reach 6.04M ETH BitMine said it acquired 12,535 ETH over the past week, bringing total holdings to 6,041,481 ETH, or about 4.9% of Ethereum’s 122.1 million supply. The company has 5.07 million ETH staked, while its total crypto, cash, marketable securities and other investments were valued at $15.1 billion as of October 18. — link

Metaplanet nears US takeover as Super League shareholders approve 2,100 BTC deal Super League shareholders approved Metaplanet’s planned investment, including the issuance of shares and warrants and the rebranding to Superplanet. At closing, Metaplanet is expected to contribute 2,100 BTC and $2.5 million in cash and would own about 93.7% of the company’s common stock. Superplanet is intended to serve as Metaplanet’s U.S.-listed Bitcoin treasury platform, while related warrants could provide up to roughly $3.4 billion in additional equity capital. — link

Hyperliquid Policy Center urges SEC to refine airdrop, secondary trading rules Hyperliquid Policy Center submitted comments on the SEC’s proposed Regulation Crypto Assets, calling for clearer treatment of free token airdrops, broader secondary trading for exempt tokens, expanded safe harbors and clearer rules for token buybacks. The SEC proposal includes exemptions for startup token offerings of up to $5 million over four years and qualifying fundraising of up to $75 million in any 12-month period. — link

Multicoin Says HYPE Is Its Hedge Fund's Largest Position, Stays With Crypto Over AI According to Bloomberg, Multicoin Capital, which manages about $2.7 billion, plans to remain focused on crypto even as peers including Paradigm, Framework Ventures and Haun Ventures expand into AI. General partner Spencer Applebaum said HYPE is currently the largest position in Multicoin’s hedge fund and was acquired through the public market, though he did not disclose the size of the holding. He added that the firm sees no reason to shift away from crypto simply to follow the AI investment boom. — link
